findings.evidenceJa: 最高の対魔力を持つセイバー
findings.governingReading: Saber possesses the highest level of Magic Resistance.
findings.explanation: Strong weakens the superlative that grounds the claimed class matchup.
The English turns a plural class of manufactured soldiers into one counterfeit dragon warrior.

findings.highlight: Perhaps they were slashed away by Saber, but the presence around this place is lessening.
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーによって打ち倒されたのか、屋敷を取り囲んでいた気配も少なくなっていた
findings.governingReading: Perhaps because Saber struck them down, the presences surrounding the house were diminishing too.
findings.explanation: But reverses a supporting causal or accompanying observation into an unexplained contrast.
The English produces a malformed comparison and loses Illya’s impressed praise.
Depressed overstates Rin’s reading of Shirou’s unconvinced expression as a psychological condition.
The English relocates the disappearing Command Spell from Shirou’s arm to his hand.

findings.highlight: I look at my left hand.
findings.governingReading: He looks at his left arm.
findings.explanation: The follow-up repeats the anatomical relocation and obscures the established placement of the Command Spells.

findings.evidenceJa: 廊下から入ってきたセイバーは
findings.governingReading: Saber comes back from the corridor clutching her chest in evident distress.
findings.explanation: The English splits one sentence into an abandoned clause and a subjectless duplicate entrance.

findings.highlight: My only concern is Saber in pain.
findings.evidenceJa: 傷ついたセイバーしか目に入らない
findings.governingReading: He can see nothing but the wounded Saber.
findings.explanation: The English changes a dangerous narrowing of perception into a general statement of concern and weakens wounded to pain.

findings.highlight: I’m slashed from my left shoulder to the waist in a single blow.
findings.evidenceJa: 肩から下まで真っ二つにされた
findings.governingReading: He is split in two from the shoulder down in a single blow.
findings.explanation: mirror moon’s conditional alternate adds a left-shoulder-to-waist trajectory absent from the bound original Japanese.

findings.highlight: The brilliant slash numbs the pain
findings.evidenceJa: 鮮やかな剣筋は痛みを遅らせ
findings.governingReading: The clean sword stroke delays the arrival of pain.
findings.explanation: Numbs changes a temporal delay caused by the cut’s sharpness into suppression of sensation.
